hero.headline: Matcha
hero.note: Exclusive matcha ingredients, layered fresh with milk, oat milk, fruit, sesame, and hojicha.

ingredients.name: Mori
ingredients.description: A deep green matcha with a rounded finish, used when Moof wants richness and body.

ingredients.name: Shiran
ingredients.description: A smoother matcha profile for clean, bright drinks and layered milk tea.

about.heading: About Moof
about.body: Moof is a specialty matcha and hojicha bar built around hand-whisked ceremonial-grade drinks, soft textures, and exclusive Japanese matcha ingredients. The menu keeps things simple: strong tea, fresh milk or oat milk, seasonal flavors, and daily small-batch bakes for takeaway.
about.storeNote: Fresh milk / oat milk. Hot / cold options available on selected drinks.

findUs.heading: Where To Find Us
findUs.body: Find Moof at Eon Shenton in the CBD, just a 5-minute walk from Tanjong Pagar MRT Station.
findUs.mrtNote: 5-minute walk from Tanjong Pagar MRT Station
